headline: AI Chatbots Misled Millions of Americans Ahead of Midterm Elections
summary: A significant portion of the U.S. population was misled by AI chatbots like ChatGPT and Copilot, which provided incorrect information ahead of the 2026 midterm elections. This widespread misinformation highlights the urgent need for better regulation and oversight of AI technologies.
whyItMatters: This incident underscores the potential for AI to spread misinformation, which can have serious consequences for democratic processes and public trust in technology.
